verdict.rationale: Secureframe publishes a rendered OpenAPI reference, and the reference page embeds the full OpenAPI 3.0.0 definition, so a machine-readable spec can be obtained from the page source. However, no separate raw-spec download URL is documented, so getting the spec means pulling it out of a roughly 490KB page rather than downloading it directly. The documented versioning policy helps a consumer track spec stability. Missing for 10: a documented direct download endpoint for the raw OpenAPI file (JSON/YAML), and independent or hands-on confirmation that the embedded spec is complete and usable by tooling.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)

citations.quote: the document embeds the full "openapi: 3.0.0 / info: title: Secureframe API" OpenAPI definition that the renderer consumes
developer.secureframe.com serves a rendered OpenAPI reference
